shape: a specific, lasting good thing a lucky person has, then a two- or three-word verdict

slides.text: having someone who still remembers the exact lie you told your mum about the cracked plate. [[steady witness]]

caption:
she still remembers the treehouse we built that fell down in the rain.
she kept the secret about the dent in the garden fence for twelve years.
send this to the sister who still covers for you when you run late.

#siblings #sisterlove #oldersiblings
alt: a drawing of a small green donkey with glasses on giving a knowing sideways look, next to text about having an older sibling who still remembers the exact lie you told your mum about a cracked plate.
